title: Pulled Pork Barbecue
description: Pulled Pork Barbecue is a dish from United States prepared with pork shoulder, barbecue sauce, apple cider vinegar, burger bun. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Oven-braised pulled pork without a barbecue smoker.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 65 minutes.
Roast the covered pork shoulder at about 135–150°C for 5–6 hours, or until fork-tender and easily shredded; check it is safely cooked.
Shred or tear the cooked components, then fold together with the listed additions.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
